raw.query:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT resolution, MAX(min_origin) AS common_first_origin, MIN(max_origin) AS common_last_origin
  FROM (
    SELECT resolution, model, mode, variate, MIN(origin) AS min_origin, MAX(origin) AS max_origin
    FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus
    WHERE resolution IN ('15s','1min')
    GROUP BY resolution, model, mode, variate
  ) s
  GROUP BY resolution
), scoped AS (
  SELECT 'full'::text AS span, f.*
  FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus f
  WHERE f.resolution IN ('15s','1min') AND f.y_true IS NOT NULL AND f.p90 IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'common'::text AS span, f.*
  FROM provenance.v_forecast_thesis_corpus f
  JOIN bounds b ON b.resolution=f.resolution AND f.origin BETWEEN b.common_first_origin AND b.common_last_origin
  WHERE f.y_true IS NOT NULL AND f.p90 IS NOT NULL
), cells AS (
  SELECT span,resolution,model,mode,variate,COUNT(*) AS denominator,AVG((y_true<=p90)::int::numeric) AS cov90
  FROM scoped GROUP BY span,resolution,model,mode,variate
), horizons AS (
  SELECT span,resolution,model,mode,variate,h,COUNT(*) AS denominator,AVG((y_true<=p90)::int::numeric) AS cov90
  FROM scoped GROUP BY span,resolution,model,mode,variate,h
)
SELECT 'model_signal_mode' AS breakdown, span, resolution, COUNT(*) AS cells, SUM(denominator) AS denominator,
       MIN(cov90) AS min_cov90, MAX(cov90) AS max_cov90,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90<0.88 OR cov90>0.90) AS outside_088_090,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90<0.88) AS below_088,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90>0.90) AS above_090
FROM cells GROUP BY span,resolution
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model_signal_mode_horizon' AS breakdown, span, resolution, COUNT(*) AS cells, SUM(denominator) AS denominator,
       MIN(cov90), MAX(cov90),
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90<0.88 OR cov90>0.90),
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90<0.88),
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cov90>0.90)
FROM horizons GROUP BY span,resolution
ORDER BY span,resolution,breakdown
raw.claimed: p90 coverage 0.88-0.90 for every model and signal at 15-second and 1-minute resolutions
raw.evidence: Both full and common denominators contradict the universal claim, and per-horizon coverage is still wider: 0.8656494231484927-0.9943732416380119 at 15s and 0.8383233532934131-0.9985272459499264 at 1min on the full span.
raw.fix: Replace the universal calibration statement with the measured model-signal-mode ranges and note substantial overcoverage, or restrict the claim to explicitly identified cells that fall within 0.88-0.90.
